m2_definition.definition: A complete rights-cleared Bhutan routing-assignment snapshot for a source-attested current national edition covers the provider's entire Dzongkhag search scope, with Dzongkhag, Gewog, post-office and five-character postal-code fields kept at their stated grain; exact source lineage, row identity, duplicates and exceptions, coverage reconciliation, validity, source and terms SHA-256, reproducible transformation, approved immutable artifacts and real AGID lookup verification are required. Postal polygons and exact civic-address/building relations are separate optional layers, never inferred from office names, codes or administrative labels.

definition_review.review_basis: The existing BT manifest required exact locator-row authority, retrieval time, edition, rights and separate geometry/building evidence but had no named M2 criterion. This defines that target, not a sample-data or code-only promotion.

locator_probe.purpose: Read-only public search using only the visible Dzongkhag selector and Search button. The historical loginForm HTML name is not an authentication operation.
locator_probe.snapshot_rule: Hash each response and the ordered observation manifest; a form repeat and one repeated district detect limited drift but cannot establish an atomic nationwide snapshot or current allocation edition.
locator_probe.malformed_table_rule: The reviewed template can omit opening tr tags. Profile only exact four-cell groups ending in a closing tr, record missing tags, and never repair or publish rows. Extra fields, spans, nested markup, partial rows or changed headers fail closed.

rights_review.postal_basis: The reviewed public locator shows no source-specific reuse grant; the current Bhutan Post downloads footer states all rights reserved. This does not prove reuse is impossible, but no exact permission for redistribution of the assignment data was established.
rights_review.nlcs_basis: The official map-services page requires application, approval and a use agreement for the described products, and payment for non-government applicants; cadastral maps are not open to the public. These rules do not license unrelated postal rows or prohibit all other Bhutan open datasets.
rights_review.upu_scope: The 02/2010 sheet defines format and gives examples, not current allocation coverage or permission for Bhutan Post data.
rights_review.authority_gates: No account, NDI login, eSakor transaction, recipient, household, Thram, plot, owner, paid map, contract, new repository, new public destination or deployment without explicit approval.
